message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。一般來說，黃金價格會在每天的交易時間內波動，您可以參考以下常見資訊來源來取得最新價格：

| 資訊來源 | 連結 |
|----------|------|
| Bloomberg 金價行情 | https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/XAUUSD:CUR |
| Kitco 黃金價格 | https://www.kitco.com/charts/livegold.html |
| Investing.com 黃金即時行情 | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold |

如果您需要更精確的數字，建議直接訪問上述網站或使用金融數據 API（如 Bloomberg、Reuters、Alpha Vantage 等）來取得即時報價。

We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or mention that it's around X. But we should be careful. We can say we don't have real-time data.
